summary: GSR V Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its public units may elect to separate the units into Class A ordinary shares and rights starting July 2, 2026. Each unit consists of one ordinary share and one-seventh of a right; whole rights entitle the holder to receive one Class A ordinary share upon a business combination. Separated shares and rights will trade on Nasdaq under GSRV and GSRVR, respectively, while units remain under GSRVU. This is a routine SPAC unit separation event, not a special situation.
